name: Latent Space Algebra (LSA)
description: Vision Transformers (ViTs) excel in semantic recognition but exhibit systematic failures in spatial reasoning tasks such as mental rotation. While often attributed to data scale, this work argues that the limitation arises from the intrinsic circuit complexity of the architecture. By formalizing spatial understanding as learning a Group Homomorphism Problem -- where latent embeddings preserve the algebraic structure of physical transformations acting on images -- we identify a fundamental computational bottleneck.
